description: Golden vectors for engine registration (ptbk-register-v1) and the heartbeat (ptbk-heartbeat-v1), spec Interfaces 1 and 4. Computed independently of this package: signing inputs, SHA-256, base32 and base64url with Python's standard library, Ed25519 signatures with OpenSSL 4.0 (`openssl pkeyutl -sign -rawin`). Hex is lowercase; the heartbeat body is the exact UTF-8 bytes sent.

key.description: RFC 8032 section 7.1 TEST 1, a published test key

registration.description: POST /v1/engines/register. sig = Ed25519 over signingInput('ptbk-register-v1', "1", linkCode, raw 32-byte public key, engineVersion, mode). The link code is 16 bytes 00..0f, a test value.

heartbeat.description: POST /v1/engines/{engineId}/heartbeat. Ptbk-Signature = ed25519=<base64url Ed25519 over signingInput('ptbk-heartbeat-v1', raw 32-byte SHA-256 of the body)>.
